user.title: Xiaomi S400 scale
user.description: Pick a discovered scale or enter its Bluetooth MAC address. The scale must be in range of a Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with `active: true`.

credentials.title: Login token
credentials.description: Scale {address}. Paste the 24 hex character **TOKEN** shown for this scale by Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor (not the 32 character BLE KEY).

data_description.bindkey: 32 hex characters (BLE KEY from the extractor). Optional, only needed for heart rate, which the scale sends in its broadcast instead of the GATT stream.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The scale rejected the login token. This happens after the scale was reset or re-added in Mi Home. Extract the token again and paste it here.

method.title: Token and BLE key
method.description: The scale's keys are stored in your Xiaomi account. Log in once to fetch them, or paste them from Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor.

cloud.title: Log in with Xiaomi Home (QR code)

progress.scan_qr:
Open **Xiaomi Home** on your phone, tap the scan icon and scan this code, then approve the login. Use the account the scale is added to.

![QR code]({qr})

Code not showing? [Open the login page]({url}). The keys are only read, nothing is changed in your account.

error.invalid_token: Token must be exactly 24 hex characters
error.invalid_bindkey: BLE key must be exactly 32 hex characters
error.cloud_failed: Xiaomi login failed or timed out. Try again, or enter the keys manually.
error.cloud_not_found: Logged in, but this scale isn't in that Xiaomi account. Check you used the account the scale was added to.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a Xiaomi S400

user.title: Person
user.description: Map a scale user profile to a person. Pick someone from Home Assistant's people (their name is used unless you type another), or just type a name. Weigh in alone once and check the **Profile ID** sensor to find which number is yours.

reconfigure.title: Person
reconfigure.description: Map a scale user profile to a person. Pick someone from Home Assistant's people (their name is used unless you type another), or just type a name. Weigh in alone once and check the **Profile ID** sensor to find which number is yours.

error.profile_in_use: Another person already uses this profile ID

init.title: Mode
init.description: The scale only stores its own evaluation (body composition, body score) and broadcasts heart rate when no one is connected during the weigh-in, so pick one:

options.live: Live: stay connected for live weight; body composition is estimated by formula, no body score or heart rate
options.after: After weigh-in: connect about 12 s after each weigh-in; the scale's own body composition, body score and heart rate (no live weight). Keep the Xiaomi app from syncing first
